topic.title: Train VideoMAE embeddings (train/*.npy) missing in latest dataset version

messages.content:
Hi @Marius Bock,

I noticed that the train VideoMAE embeddings (train/*.npy - 768×15 paired 1:1 by stem) appear to be missing from the latest dataset release, while test/test_videomae_data.npy (1.05GB) and train/inertial_feat/sbj_*.csv (22 files) are present.

Context: We are currently processing ~62k windows using Pooled 1536→192 / Inception+Transformer (0.83M parameters) based on the [TS/Emb] 3WDC structure from 2026-08-30.

Could you clarify:

  1. Is the train/*.npy VideoMAE embedding set intended to be re-uploaded or generated via a script?
  2. If generated via script, is there an official baseline script/checkpoint for feature extraction consistency?
  3. Are the test set embeddings formatted identically to the expected training embeddings?

Thanks!
